cards.English: Could you please show me how to [[apply ice to]] my chin?
cards.Trap: Could you please show me, how I am supposed to [[cool]] my chin area in the first days?
cards.Transfer1: You should [[apply ice to]] the swollen area for ten minutes.
cards.Transfer2: Remember to [[ice]] your jaw twice a day.
cards.Rule: Körperstellen medizinisch kühlen heißt to apply ice to oder to ice, nicht to cool.

cards.German: Gibt es hier jemanden, der mir beim Tragen meines Gepäcks helfen kann?
cards.English: Is there anyone [[who can help me carry]] my luggage?
cards.Trap: Is there anyone, [[who could help me to transport]] my luggage?
cards.Transfer1: Do you know anyone [[who can help me move]] these boxes?
cards.Rule: Kein Komma vor who, und Gepäck transportieren im Reisealltag heißt carry oder with my luggage, nicht transport.
cards.Alternative1: Is there anyone who can help me with my luggage?

cards.German: Ich habe mein Zimmer für fünf Nächte gebucht, aber ich muss möglicherweise meinen Aufenthalt verlängern.
cards.English: I booked my room for five nights, but I [[might need to extend]] my stay.
cards.Trap: I booked my room for 5 nights, but I [[probably need to stay one day longer]].
cards.Transfer1: I [[might need to extend]] my trip if the doctor advises it.
cards.Rule: Für eine vorsichtige Notwendigkeit (möglicherweise müssen) ist might need to extend my stay idiomatisch.
cards.Alternative1: I booked for five nights, but I may have to stay an extra day.

cards.German: Früher hatte ich nie Beschwerden beim Kauen oder Sprechen.
cards.English: I [[never used to have]] issues with chewing or speaking.
cards.Trap: [[In the past I never had]] issues with eating or speaking.
cards.Transfer1: I [[never used to have]] pain in my jaw.
cards.Transfer2: He [[used to work]] in a different clinic.
cards.Rule: Dauerhafte Zustände oder Gewohnheiten in der Vergangenheit, die heute anders sind, drückt man mit used to aus; Kauen heißt chewing.
cards.Alternative1: I never had any problems chewing or speaking before.

cards.German: Was für Risiken gibt es, falls der Muskel nicht richtig anwächst?
cards.English: What are the risks [[if the muscle does not reattach]] properly?
cards.Trap: What kind of risks are there, [[when the muscle doesn't attach]] properly ?
cards.Pattern: What are the risks + [[if]] + [Gewebe] + does not + [Verb]?
cards.Transfer1: What happens [[if the bone does not heal]] correctly?
cards.Rule: Für Bedingungen (falls) nutzt man if (nicht when); chirurgisches Wiederanwachsen heißt reattach.
cards.Alternative1: What risks are there if the muscle fails to heal properly?

cards.German: Morgen um diese Zeit werde ich im Flugzeug nach São Paulo sitzen.
cards.English: [[This time tomorrow]], I [[will be on the plane]] to São Paulo.
cards.Trap: [[Tomorrow this time]], I [[will sit in the plane]] to Sao Paulo.
cards.Transfer1: [[This time tomorrow]], I [[will be sitting]] in the consultation room.
cards.Transfer2: [[This time next week]], I [[will be flying]] back home.
cards.Rule: Die Redewendung lautet This time tomorrow, Transportmittel nutzen on the plane, und laufende Zukunftsakte stehen im Future Continuous.
cards.Alternative1: This time tomorrow, I will be flying to São Paulo.

cards.German: Ich bezweifle, dass der Arzt den Verband schon vor Freitag abnehmen wird.
cards.English: I [[doubt that]] the doctor will [[remove the dressing]] before Friday.
cards.Trap: I [[bezweifle, that]] the doctor will [[take the bandage off]] before friday.
cards.Transfer1: I [[doubt that]] the surgeon will approve the flight so soon.
cards.Rule: Bezweifeln heißt to doubt, und der medizinische Wundverband wird fachlich dressing genannt (abnehmen = remove).
cards.Alternative1: I don't think the doctor will take off the bandage before Friday.

cards.German: Ich lerne Englisch, um mich während meines Aufenthalts verständigen zu können.
cards.English: I am learning English so that I can communicate [[during my stay]].
cards.Trap: I am learning englisch, to be able to speak [[while my aufenthalt]].
cards.Transfer1: I need a translator [[during the consultation]].
cards.Transfer2: You must rest [[during your recovery]].
cards.Rule: Vor einem Nomen heißt während immer during (while verlangt ein Verb), und sich verständigen heißt to communicate.
cards.Alternative1: I'm practicing English to communicate properly during my stay in Brazil.

cards.German: Hast du gestern die Buchungsbestätigung erhalten?
cards.English: [[Did you receive]] the [[booking confirmation]] yesterday?
cards.Trap: [[Did you received]] the [[buchungsbestätigung]] yesterday?
cards.Transfer1: [[Did you get]] the invoice from the clinic?
cards.Transfer2: [[Did you sign]] the consent form?
cards.Rule: Nach Did you steht das Verb immer in der Grundform (receive, nie received).
cards.Alternative1: Did you get the booking confirmation yesterday?

cards.German: Als ich das Hotelzimmer betrat, hatte der Zimmerservice das Bett bereits gemacht.
cards.English: When I [[entered]] the hotel room, [[housekeeping]] had already [[made]] the bed.
cards.Trap: When I [[betrat]] the hotel room, the [[Zimmerservice]] had already [[done]] the bed.
cards.Pattern: When + [Past Simple], [Subjekt] + [[had already made]] + the bed
cards.Transfer1: When I checked in, [[housekeeping]] had already cleaned the bathroom.
cards.Rule: Zimmerreinigung heißt housekeeping (room service bringt nur Essen), und das Bett machen heißt make the bed.
cards.Alternative1: When I walked into the hotel room, housekeeping had already made the bed.

cards.German: Mein Reisepass wurde am Flughafen kontrolliert.
cards.English: My [[passport]] was [[checked]] [[at]] the airport.
cards.Trap: My [[pass]] was [[controlled]] [[in]] the airport.
cards.Transfer1: My boarding pass was [[checked at]] the gate.
cards.Transfer2: Our bags were [[checked at]] security.
cards.Rule: Reisepass heißt passport, kontrollieren heißt check (control bedeutet steuern), und am Flughafen heißt at the airport.
cards.Alternative1: They checked my passport at the airport.

cards.German: Sobald ich am Hotel ankomme, werde ich mich kurz hinlegen.
cards.English: When I arrive at the hotel, I will [[lie down]] for a bit.
cards.Trap: When I arrive at the hotel, I will [[lay down]] for a bit.
cards.Transfer1: After the surgery, you should [[lie down]] and rest.
cards.Rule: Sich selbst hinlegen heißt lie down (lay bedeutet einen Gegenstand ablegen).
cards.Alternative1: As soon as I get to the hotel, I'll lie down for a little while.

cards.German: Ich möchte, dass der Arzt sich mein Kinn noch einmal genauer ansieht.
cards.English: I want the doctor to [[take a closer look at]] my chin.
cards.Trap: I want the doctor to [[check]] my chin [[genauer]].
cards.Pattern: want + [Person] + to + [[take a closer look at]] + [Körperteil]
cards.Transfer1: Could you [[take a closer look at]] the sutures?
cards.Rule: Sich etwas genauer ansehen heißt idiomatisch take a closer look at oder examine more closely.
cards.Alternative1: I want the doctor to examine my chin more closely.

cards.German: Ich gewöhne mich langsam an das warme Wetter hier.
cards.English: I [[am getting used to]] the warm weather here.
cards.Trap: I [[get used to]] the warm weather here.
cards.Transfer1: I [[am getting used to]] sleeping with my head elevated.
cards.Transfer2: He [[is getting used to]] the new climate.
cards.Rule: Ein Gewöhnungsprozess, der gerade jetzt stattfindet, steht im Present Continuous (am getting used to).
cards.Alternative1: I'm slowly getting used to the warm weather here.

cards.German: Bist du schon einmal alleine geflogen?
cards.English: [[Have you ever flown]] alone?
cards.Trap: [[Did you ever fly]] alone?
cards.Transfer1: [[Have you ever traveled]] to South America?
cards.Transfer2: [[Have you ever had]] a patient from Germany?
cards.Rule: Die Frage nach einer generellen Lebenserfahrung verlangt immer Have you ever + 3. Form, niemals Did you ever.

cards.German: Ich mache diese Ausbildung nun seit einem Monat.
cards.English: I [[have been doing]] this apprenticeship [[for]] one month.
cards.Trap: I [[am doing]] this apprenticeship [[since]] one month.
cards.Transfer1: I [[have been waiting]] here [[for]] two hours.
cards.Transfer2: I [[have been working]] there [[for]] three weeks.
cards.Rule: Handlungen, die bis heute andauern, stehen im Present Perfect Continuous (have been doing). Zeitspannen verlangen for (nicht since).
cards.Alternative1: I've been completing this apprenticeship for a month now.

cards.German: Ich lerne seit heute Morgen Englisch für meine Reise.
cards.English: I [[have been learning]] English for my trip [[since]] this morning.
cards.Trap: I [[am learning]] English for my trip [[since]] this morning.
cards.Transfer1: I [[have been studying]] [[since]] 8 AM.
cards.Transfer2: I [[have been feeling]] pain [[since]] yesterday.
cards.Rule: Bei seit plus Startpunkt (heute Morgen) nutzt man Present Perfect Continuous (have been -ing) und since. Niemals I am learning.
cards.Alternative1: I've been practicing English for my trip since this morning.

cards.German: Sobald ich die Dokumente ausgefüllt habe, schicke ich sie ab.
cards.English: [[Once I have filled out]] the documents, I will send them.
cards.Trap: [[Once I filled out]] the documents, I will send them.
cards.Transfer1: [[Once I have finished]] the report, I will call you.
cards.Transfer2: [[Once you have signed]] the form, we can proceed.
cards.Rule: Sobald etwas in der Zukunft fertiggestellt ist, drückt man das im Englischen mit Once + Present Perfect (have + 3. Form) aus.
cards.Alternative1: As soon as I've filled out the paperwork, I'll send it over.

cards.German: Sobald die Narbe verheilt ist, werde ich ins Fitnessstudio gehen.
cards.English: [[Once the scar has healed]], I will go to the gym.
cards.Trap: [[Once the scar is healed out]], I will go to the gym.
cards.Transfer1: [[Once the swelling has gone down]], you can eat normally.
cards.Transfer2: [[Once the anesthesia has worn off]], you can leave.
cards.Rule: Für eine abgeschlossene Bedingung in der Zukunft (sobald) nutzt man Once + Present Perfect. Medizinisches Verheilen ist einfach heal.
cards.Alternative1: As soon as the scar heals, I'm going to the gym.
